---
title: "Immune Classifier, Step 3: Stratified Train/Test/Validation Split"
author: "Meite I, Pesce L, Feinstein M, Thorp EB, Lantz C"
date: "2026-03-06"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(yaml)
})

# Configuration 
cat("Phase 3: Three-Way Data Splitting\n")

# Load config
config_path <- "/projects/b1246/Isaac/immune_classifier/config/config.yaml"
config <- yaml::read_yaml(config_path)

cat("Configuration loaded\n")

# Load Atlas with PCA
cat("\n[1/6] Loading atlas with PCA...\n")

atlas_path <- file.path(config$paths$data_dir, "processed", "atlas_with_pca.rds")
if (!file.exists(atlas_path)) {
  stop("Atlas with PCA not found. Run Phase 2 first: ", atlas_path)
}

seurat_atlas <- readRDS(atlas_path)

cat(sprintf("Loaded atlas with %s cells and %s cell types\n",
            format(ncol(seurat_atlas), big.mark = ","),
            length(unique(seurat_atlas$cell_type))))

# Check Cell Type Counts
cat("\n[2/6] Checking cell type distribution...\n")

cell_type_counts <- table(seurat_atlas$cell_type)
cell_type_df <- data.frame(
  Cell_Type = names(cell_type_counts),
  Count = as.numeric(cell_type_counts)
) %>% arrange(desc(Count))

cat("\n Cell type counts:\n")
print(cell_type_df, row.names = FALSE)

# Check for cell types that are too rare to split
min_cells_required <- 15  # Minimum cells for a three-way split
rare_types <- cell_type_df %>% filter(Count < min_cells_required)

if (nrow(rare_types) > 0) {
  print(rare_types, row.names = FALSE)
  cat("\n  These will be split, but validation/test sets may have very few cells.\n\n")
}

# Stratified Three-Way Split
cat("\n[3/6] Performing stratified three-way split...\n")

# Get split parameters
set.seed(config$splitting$random_seed)
train_pct <- config$splitting$train_pct
test_pct <- config$splitting$test_pct
val_pct <- config$splitting$validation_pct

cat(sprintf("  Random seed: %d\n", config$splitting$random_seed))
cat(sprintf("  Split ratios: Train=%.0f%%, Test=%.0f%%, Validation=%.0f%%\n",
            train_pct * 100, test_pct * 100, val_pct * 100))

# Initialize split column
seurat_atlas$split <- NA

# Split each cell type separately (stratified)
cell_types <- unique(seurat_atlas$cell_type)

for (ct in cell_types) {
  # Get cells of this type
  ct_cells <- colnames(seurat_atlas)[seurat_atlas$cell_type == ct]
  n_cells <- length(ct_cells)
  
  # Calculate split sizes
  n_train <- round(n_cells * train_pct)
  n_test <- round(n_cells * test_pct)
  n_val <- n_cells - n_train - n_test  # remaining cells
  
  # Shuffle cells
  shuffled_cells <- sample(ct_cells)
  
  # Assign to splits
  train_cells <- shuffled_cells[1:n_train]
  test_cells <- shuffled_cells[(n_train + 1):(n_train + n_test)]
  val_cells <- shuffled_cells[(n_train + n_test + 1):n_cells]
  
  # Update metadata
  seurat_atlas$split[colnames(seurat_atlas) %in% train_cells] <- "train"
  seurat_atlas$split[colnames(seurat_atlas) %in% test_cells] <- "test"
  seurat_atlas$split[colnames(seurat_atlas) %in% val_cells] <- "validation"
}

cat("Split assignments complete\n")

# Verify Split Proportions
cat("\n[4/6] Verifying split proportions...\n")

# Overall proportions
split_summary <- table(seurat_atlas$split)
split_pct <- prop.table(split_summary) * 100

cat("\n Overall split distribution:\n")
for (split_name in names(split_summary)) {
  cat(sprintf("  %s: %d cells (%.1f%%)\n",
              split_name,
              split_summary[split_name],
              split_pct[split_name]))
}

# Per cell type verification
split_by_type <- table(seurat_atlas$cell_type, seurat_atlas$split)
split_by_type_df <- as.data.frame.matrix(split_by_type)
split_by_type_df$Cell_Type <- rownames(split_by_type_df)
split_by_type_df <- split_by_type_df %>%
  select(Cell_Type, train, test, validation) %>%
  arrange(desc(train))

cat("  Split distribution by cell type:\n")
print(split_by_type_df, row.names = FALSE)

# Check for cell types with too few cells in any split
min_cells_per_split <- 3
problematic_types <- split_by_type_df %>%
  filter(train < min_cells_per_split | 
         test < min_cells_per_split | 
         validation < min_cells_per_split)

if (nrow(problematic_types) > 0) {
  print(problematic_types, row.names = FALSE)
  cat("\n  Consider merging these cell types or excluding them from training.\n\n")
}

# Visualize Splits
cat("\n[5/6] Generating split visualizations...\n")

results_dir <- file.path(config$paths$results_dir, "figures", "phase3_splits")
dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Bar plot of split proportions by cell type
split_long <- split_by_type_df %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = c(train, test, validation),
                      names_to = "Split",
                      values_to = "Count")

p_splits <- ggplot(split_long, aes(x = Cell_Type, y = Count, fill = Split)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "train" = "#2E7D32",
    "test" = "#1976D2",
    "validation" = "#F57C00"
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "Data Split Distribution by Cell Type",
    x = "Cell Type",
    y = "Number of Cells",
    fill = "Split"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(results_dir, "split_distribution_by_celltype.png"),
  plot = p_splits,
  width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300
)

cat(sprintf("Saved visualizations to: %s\n", results_dir))

# Save Split Assignments
cat("\n[6/6] Saving split assignments...\n")

# Save atlas with split assignments
output_path <- file.path(config$paths$data_dir, "processed", "atlas_with_splits.rds")
saveRDS(seurat_atlas, output_path)

cat(sprintf("Saved atlas with splits to: %s\n", output_path))
cat(sprintf("  File size: %.2f MB\n", file.size(output_path) / 1024^2))

# Save split summary for reference
metrics_dir <- file.path(config$paths$results_dir, "metrics")
dir.create(metrics_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

write.csv(
  split_by_type_df,
  file = file.path(metrics_dir, "phase3_split_summary.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat(sprintf("Saved split summary to: %s\n",
            file.path(metrics_dir, "phase3_split_summary.csv")))

# Summary
cat("Phase 3 Complete: Three-Way Data Splitting\n")

cat("Summary:\n")
cat(sprintf("Total cells: %s\n", format(ncol(seurat_atlas), big.mark = ",")))
cat(sprintf("Training cells: %d (%.1f%%)\n",
            split_summary["train"], split_pct["train"]))
cat(sprintf("Testing cells: %d (%.1f%%)\n",
            split_summary["test"], split_pct["test"]))
cat(sprintf("Validation cells: %d (%.1f%%)\n",
            split_summary["validation"], split_pct["validation"]))
cat(sprintf("Cell types: %d\n", length(unique(seurat_atlas$cell_type))))
cat(sprintf("Random seed: %d\n", config$splitting$random_seed))


```
